# NOVI

> Premium, India-specific dog shampoos - sulphate-free, paraben-free, pH balanced, and formulated specifically for Indian water, climate, and coats.

NOVI makes three dog shampoo formulas, each built for a specific need rather than one general-purpose product: tick and flea defence, everyday care for hard water and humidity, and a gentle formula for puppies and sensitive skin. All formulas are Niacinamide-enriched, PETA-listed cruelty-free, and disclose complete INCI ingredient lists.

## Products

- [Tick & Flea Defence (F01)](https://novipets.in/product/1): Neem, Citronella, and Lemongrass formula for dogs in tick-prone conditions.
- [Neem and Oat Everyday (F02)](https://novipets.in/product/2): Everyday formula for dogs coping with India's hard water and humidity.
- [Puppy & Sensitive (F03)](https://novipets.in/product/3): Tear-free, gentle formula for puppies and sensitive skin.
